legend.expected_class: DEFAULT | IMPORTANT_I | IMPORTANT_II | CRITICAL | UNRESOLVED | NOT_ASSERTED
legend.NOT_ASSERTED: The case tests engine behaviour rather than this outcome. A comparison must treat NOT_ASSERTED as 'no claim', never as a disagreement.
legend.expected_category: For per-category pairs only: which category, and whether it should match.

status: Statuses follow DR-04. AUTHOR_VERIFIED means the conditions trace verbatim to official text we hold; AUTHOR_INTERPRETATION means our reading goes beyond the literal text; OPEN_QUESTION means the law is undetermined and the engine must not resolve it. No status asserts legal endorsement.

cases.scenario: Component for a type-approved motor vehicle
cases.expected_behaviour: Art. 2(2)(c) exclusion where that Regulation applies to the product
cases.contested: We keep OUT, but the reviewer's caution is reasonable: whether Reg. 2019/2144 applies to a component rather than the vehicle should be confirmed.
cases.review_change: Round 2: Reg. (EU) 2019/2144 Art. 2 expressly covers systems, components and separate technical units for vehicle categories M, N and O, and the Commission guidance (s.9.3.1) distinguishes components EXCLUSIVELY designed and constructed for covered vehicles (excluded) from generic components that merely can be integrated (not excluded). Our scenario establishes only use in a type-approved vehicle, not exclusivity. Changed from OUT to UNRESOLVED.

cases.scenario: Exclusion claimed but applicable instrument unidentified
cases.expected_behaviour: No exclusion granted; question returned
cases.review_change: Reviewer correction, accepted: where the basis for a claimed exclusion is UNKNOWN, scope is UNRESOLVED. Treating it as IN converts an UNKNOWN into a FALSE, which is the thing our own four-valued model forbids.

cases.scenario: Avionics product within scope of Reg. 2018/1139 but not certified under it

cases.scenario: Sectoral rules claimed to cover the Annex I risks
cases.expected_behaviour: No exclusion unless a delegated act under Art. 2(5) actually says so; absence of an act is not an exclusion
cases.contested: We keep IN. Art. 2(5) requires a delegated act for the limitation to exist; the absence of one is determinable, not unknown, so this is not the EXC-06 situation.
cases.review_change: Round 2 plus verification: the reasoning changes even though the answer does not. An Art. 2(5) delegated act DOES exist (2025/1535); the test is whether an applicable one covers this product.

cases.scenario: Smart lock marketed for short-term rental use — "residential and Airbnb"
cases.expected_behaviour: `RESIDENTIAL_SETTING` = `CONFLICTING`; reviewer flag rather than a choice. Short-term rental is neither an ordinary home nor a commercial building
cases.review_change: Round 2 confirms, same qualification. Not a universal rule that any mention of residential use establishes III-I-17.

cases.scenario: Same lock, marketing claims both home and office use
cases.expected_behaviour: `CONFLICTING` + review flag; no silent choice
cases.review_change: Round 2 confirms, with a qualification we must encode: residential use must be GENUINE intended purpose (Art. 3(23) - instructions, promotional materials, statements, technical documentation), not merely mentioned. A residential claim contradicted by design or technical documentation is UNRESOLVED, not IMPORTANT_I.

cases.review_change: Round 2: the reviewer RETRACTED their round-1 DEFAULT, concluding UNRESOLVED is more defensible where a product plausibly meets the second limb. Our position is unchanged and now has an argued second reading behind it.

cases.review_change: Round 2: same retraction. cases.scenario: AI-enabled machine whose AI system is high-risk under Art. 6(1) only via the Machinery Regulation, now in Section B of AI Act Annex I
cases.expected_behaviour: CRA class unchanged; Art. 43 route of CRA Art. 12(2) not asserted (AI Act Art. 2(2) as amended by 2026/1744 excludes Art. 43); flagged for expert review
cases.source: B11c Art. 2(2), Annex I Section B point 21

cases.scenario: High-risk AI product (via Annex I) placed on the market between 11-12-2027 and 2-8-2028
cases.expected_behaviour: Conformity route date-qualified; whether CRA Art. 12 applies in the window is not resolved
cases.source: B11c Art. 113(c)

cases.scenario: Product with digital elements classified as an EHR system under Reg. (EU) 2025/327
cases.expected_behaviour: CRA class unchanged; conformity with CRA Annex I via EHDS Chapter III procedure (CRA Art. 32(5a), from 26-3-2027)

cases.scenario: Embedded web view that loads and renders remote web pages but has script execution disabled
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate. Script execution is something browsers 'typically include', not a condition; accessing and rendering server-hosted web content (C1) is what matters. Pairs with CAT-02N, which fails C1
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Password vault that stores passwords locally but offers no generation, sharing or application integration
cases.decisive_fact: C2 is illustrative ('including activities such as')
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate. Storing passwords (C1) is the defining function; generation, sharing and integration are listed examples. CAT-03N is excluded because note-taking, not password storage, is its core function

expected_category.condition: C2 is illustrative ('including activities such as')

cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Tool that only quarantines and removes files already flagged as malicious by another product
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate via the 'removes or quarantines' limb, without its own detection
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Dedicated configuration management system that pushes configuration to routers and switches but does not monitor them
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate. The description names 'dedicated configuration management systems' as included, so monitoring is not treated as strictly required. Inventory conditions C1+C2 read as conjunctive and need the same note
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Observability platform that collects and correlates data from many sources for application performance, with no security use
cases.expected_behaviour: Category excluded; fails C3 only (actionable information 'for security-related purposes')
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Standalone tool that analyses the logs of a single firewall and raises security alerts
cases.expected_behaviour: Category excluded; fails C1 only (data from multiple sources)
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Single-stage boot loader that initialises hardware and loads one fixed kernel, with no boot option selection
cases.decisive_fact: inclusion list vs C3 (selecting boot options)
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate. The description names single-stage boot loaders as included, so selecting boot options is not treated as strictly required

expected_category.condition: inclusion list vs C3 (selecting boot options)

cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Key vault managing symmetric keys and secrets, with no digital certificates involved
cases.expected_behaviour: Category excluded. Key lifecycle counts only for keys 'associated with such digital certificates' within a PKI
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Virtual network interface driver for VPN or container networking, placed on the market as a standalone product
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate via the virtual network interface limb
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Industrial modem providing a point-to-point serial link over a leased line, not used for IP-based Internet communication
cases.decisive_fact: modem limb: intended for connection to the Internet
cases.expected_behaviour: Modem limb excluded: not 'intended for the connection to the Internet' nor converting signals 'for IP-based communication'

expected_category.condition: modem limb: intended for connection to the Internet

cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Unmanaged desktop Ethernet switch with no management plane
cases.expected_behaviour: Switch limb excluded: switches in this category 'have a management plane'
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: System-on-chip with integrated memory and a TEE that secures the host device
cases.expected_behaviour: Class I either way. Whether it is a microprocessor (external memory) or a microcontroller (integrated memory) need not be resolved for the class; the engine may list both with that reason
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Voice assistant appliance for office meeting rooms that controls room equipment and online calendars
cases.expected_behaviour: Category excluded; fails 'in residential settings' only
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Smart door lock operated only by Bluetooth from a phone nearby, with no hub, cloud or other remote path
cases.expected_behaviour: Unresolved whether control by a nearby phone app is control 'remotely from other systems'. Engine must not decide; review flag
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Internet-connected toy with GPS location tracking and no microphone, speaker, camera or keyboard
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate via the location-tracking limb. Pairs with CAT-18N (proximity only)
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Internet-connected collectible figure with microphone and speaker, designed and marketed for adult collectors
cases.expected_behaviour: Category excluded if not a toy within the Directive (not designed or intended for play by children under 14). The toy test is a judgement; record the reason
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Walkie-talkie toy pair with microphone and speaker communicating only with each other by radio, never with the Internet
cases.expected_behaviour: Category excluded; fails 'communicate on the public Internet, whether directly or via other equipment'
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Child GPS smartwatch with calling but no health sensing, for children under 14
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate via the children's wearable limb, which has no health-monitoring condition
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Adult smartwatch showing notifications only, with no sensors for health or body metrics
cases.expected_behaviour: Category excluded; fails C2 and the children's limb does not apply
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Container runtime managing container execution and lifecycle on a single host, placed on the market as a product
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate via the container runtime limb
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Multi-host container orchestration control plane that schedules containers but delegates execution to runtimes on each node
cases.decisive_fact: container runtime: single host, manages execution
cases.expected_behaviour: Unresolved whether an orchestrator is a container runtime system ('on a single host operating system', 'manage the execution'). Engine must not decide; review flag

expected_category.condition: container runtime: single host, manages execution

cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Host-based intrusion detection system that only detects and alerts
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate via the IDS limb; active response is needed only for IPS
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Network traffic analytics for bandwidth planning that neither restricts traffic nor detects intrusions
cases.expected_behaviour: Category excluded; fails both firewall and IDS limbs
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Microcontroller with security functions for the host, no tamper resistance and no AVA_VAN claim
cases.expected_behaviour: Excluded from III-II-04 (CAT-23N) but candidate for III-I-14; the class falls to Class I, not to DEFAULT
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Tamper-resistant microcontroller designed to AVA_VAN.4
cases.expected_behaviour: IV-03 candidate (secure element), not III-II-04, which covers AVA_VAN 2 or 3 only. Pairs with CAT-23P at AVA_VAN 2
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Tamper-resistant microcontroller designed to AVA_VAN.3
cases.expected_behaviour: IV-03 excluded on C3 alone; lands in III-II-04. Single-condition replacement for CAT-26N, which fails two conditions
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Multi-component industrial computer storing keys in software, with no tamper-evident or tamper-resistant enclosure
cases.expected_behaviour: IV-01 excluded on C3 alone. Single-condition replacement for CAT-24N, which fails two conditions
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Payment terminal with a tamper-responsive enclosure around multiple discrete components
cases.expected_behaviour: Candidate; physical payment terminals are named in the description
cases.source: B2 technical description; WP5 condition audit

cases.scenario: Unit placed in 2026; change after 11-12-2027 modifies the intended purpose
cases.expected_behaviour: Substantial modification: main requirements apply from the change. The purpose limb is decidable, unlike limb (a)
cases.source: B1c Art. 3(30), 69, 71; B16; WP7 timeline trial

cases.scenario: Same purpose change, but made before 11-12-2027
cases.expected_behaviour: Transition holds: Art. 69(2) counts only substantial modifications 'from that date'
cases.source: B1c Art. 3(30), 69, 71; B16; WP7 timeline trial

cases.scenario: Certificate under other legislation that expires before 11-06-2028
cases.expected_behaviour: Validity ends at the certificate's own expiry, not 11-06-2028 (Art. 69(1) 'unless they expire before that date')
cases.source: B1c Art. 3(30), 69, 71; B16; WP7 timeline trial

cases.scenario: RED-covered radio equipment placed on the market before 1-8-2025
cases.decisive_fact: placed before the delegated act applied
cases.expected_behaviour: RED DA cybersecurity requirements do not apply to those units
cases.source: B1c Art. 3(30), 69, 71; B16; WP7 timeline trial

cases.scenario: RED-covered radio equipment, placing date unknown
cases.expected_behaviour: RED DA and main requirements UNRESOLVED; Art. 14 still stated as applying, since Art. 69(3) does not depend on the placing date
cases.source: B1c Art. 3(30), 69, 71; B16; WP7 timeline trial

cases.scenario: Connected navigation equipment within the scope of Directive 2014/90/EU (marine equipment)
cases.expected_behaviour: Excluded by Art. 2(4). Previously the only Art. 2 exclusion with no case
cases.source: B1c Art. 2; WP7 scope trial

cases.scenario: Defence exclusion claimed by the user, with no supporting document
cases.expected_behaviour: No exclusion yet: UNRESOLVED with a request for evidence. The exclusion is the permissive answer, so it needs documentary support (as EXC-05 says)
cases.source: B1c Art. 2; WP7 scope trial

cases.scenario: Product in development; sale on the EU market planned, not yet started
cases.expected_behaviour: IN_SCOPE, stated as prospective: applies from first making available. Pairs with SCP-08, where no sale is decided
cases.source: B1c Art. 2; WP7 scope trial
